svg.text: mm · L = panel LEFT edge to opening LEFT edge. Below panels: clear gaps; R = final right gap.

g.text: All mm, shown to 0.001 mm. L is from the panel left cut edge; gap is clear edge-to-edge.
R is shown only for the final opening on each panel. Sill is measured up from panel bottom.
